subject: Hosted API: token-envelope-to-budget-mapping (post-demo)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: token-envelope-to-budget-mapping (post-demo)

Hi Samir —

Thanks for taking time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we have a single source of truth before we draft a formal quote: 

Summary of usage profile (what we captured on the call)
- Expected monthly token footprint: 14M–20M tokens (this includes approx. 12M–16M conversation tokens + 2M embeddings/utility tokens).
- Peak concurrency: 220 TPS (99th percentile peak during short bursts; typical sustained windows ~25–40 TPS).
- Traffic shape: steady baseline with 1–2 short daily bursts (2–6 minutes) during batch jobs/marketing events.

Pricing target and asks
- Your budget reference: target unit economics roughly $9–$12 per 1M tokens (you said $10/M as a midpoint).
- Ask from Redwood: confirm the monthly envelope you want us to price against and whether you want committed slabs (monthly or annual) vs. a flexible pay-as-you-go rate. Committed slabs unlock deeper discounts.

Operational constraints we should account for
- Need for audit logs and retention (you flagged 12 months minimum).
- IP/data isolation: currently fine with hosted API but you may escalate to Dedicated if traffic or compliance changes.

Next concrete steps (proposed)
1) You confirm final monthly token envelope to price (pick a single band or a small range).
2) We return a 1-page pricing options sheet showing: payg rate, 3 commitment bands (6mo, 12mo, 24mo) with discount curves, and example $/1M math.
3) If comfortable, we follow with a simple SOW + DocuSign link for signature and procurement review.

I attached a working pricing model (novacorp_pricing_model_v1.xlsx) and a short sample SOW template for reference.

If you want, we can also run a short peak-sim (1 hour) on our hosted stack to validate latency at 220 TPS before committing to a band.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: novacorp_pricing_model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, draft), redwood_sample_sow_v1.pdf (SOW template)

Thanks Grace — this is great, and matches my notes. Two quick clarifications: 
1) Can you show the estimated $/1M math for both conversation tokens and embeddings (I want to see the blended rate vs separate rates).
2) Do you typically require a commit to get down into the $9–12/M band? If so, what does a 12mo commitment look like for us at 16M tokens/mo?

Procurement is looped in on a separate address but we're fine if you start with a pricing options sheet first. Also interested in the one-hour peak-sim — would be useful to validate latency.

—Samir

Subject: Re: Hosted API: token-envelope-to-budget-mapping (post-demo)

Grace — forwarding a short note on pricing bands (copying Karthik):

(Quoted) On Sun, Mar 8, 2026 at 4:23 PM Grace O'Connor wrote:
> - Expected monthly token footprint: 14M–20M tokens
> - Peak concurrency: 220 TPS (99th percentile)

Recommended pricing approach for first pass:
- Pay-as-you-go baseline: $15 / 1M tokens (no commitment).
- Medium commit band (6–12 mo): $11 / 1M tokens for 8–16M tokens/mo committed. Example math for 16M tokens: $176/month (16 * $11).
- High commit band (12–24 mo): $8.50 / 1M tokens for 16M+ tokens/mo committed with usage true-up. That gets you into the $8–9 region Samir referenced.

Discount levers we can offer: 1) minimum monthly commit, 2) upfront payment term (annual prepay yields extra 5% off), 3) small on-contract SLA bump for dedicated routing windows (this is negotiable).

If they want blended conversation + embedding math, we can show a split: conversation tokens priced at the band rate, embeddings at 0.6x band rate (example: if band = $11, embeddings = $6.6).

I'll draft a one-pager with three numbered options and example monthly invoices by EOD Pacific.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks — all looks sensible. Procurement is okay to proceed with a 12mo commitment evaluation. Two asks before we sign: 
1) Can you provide the blended example invoice for 16M tokens/mo (conversation + embeddings split) showing: payg, 12mo commit, and annual-prepay 12mo? I want line items (tokens, unit price, subtotal).
2) Can Redwood confirm SLOs for the hosted API at the 99th percentile (latency target and any remediation credits) so we can include a short SLA appendix in the SOW?

If you can get the one-pager and the invoice examples to procurement by EOD Pacific tomorrow, we'll route internally for a fast-track review. Also please include the 1-hour peak-sim dates/options.
